name: SRX Code Upgrade
description: Storage check, cleanup, code pull, upgrade, reboot and verify for SRX devices.

spec.question_description: Full URL to the Junos package. The SRX pulls it directly, so it must be reachable from the device. Leave blank only if you are using the per-model map below.

JSON object of model to URL, for inventories with mixed SRX models. Overrides Image URL for any model listed. Example: {"SRX345": "http://.../junos-srxsme-23.4R2-S5.5.tgz", "SRX1500": "http://.../junos-srxentedge-23.4R2-S5.5.tgz"}
Normally parsed from the image filename (23.4R2-S5.5). Set this only if the filename does not contain a parseable version.
true = run the storage check, cleanup and consolidate, report whether each device is ready, and stop before installing anything.
true = upgrade even if the device already reports the target version. Devices already on target are skipped otherwise.
How many devices to upgrade concurrently. Keep at 1 to take down one box at a time.
The upgrade is blocked if less than this is free on the Junos partition after cleanup.
Runs 'request system storage cleanup' before installing.
Runs 'request system storage consolidate'. Branch SRX only; skipped harmlessly elsewhere.
Ceiling for the combined download and install. Raise it for slow links or large images.
How often the job output prints a progress line while the install runs.
How long to wait for the device to come back on NETCONF after rebooting.
